artifact_type: promotion blocker repair gate and executable evidence plan
blocked_direct_promotion_reason_ru: P17E candidate is artifact-only and weaker/smaller than the existing common checkpoint. Direct copy would overwrite current runtime/common state without positive compatibility, rollback, fresh-load, manifest/locator, and API/firewall evidence.

blockers.required_repair: Produce a positive source-disjoint compatibility/non-regression eval where candidate metrics are explicitly compared with the existing common model.
blockers.forbidden_shortcut: Do not rewrite accuracyAtExport from 0 to a positive value without a runner-emitted eval artifact.
blockers.required_test_or_probe: Focused compatibility/non-regression test must parse candidate metrics and assert candidate is not worse than existing common behavior on source-disjoint rows.

blockers.required_repair: Keep semanticQualityClaimed false until source-disjoint eval, ablation, fresh-load, continue-training, and API/firewall gates all pass with positive evidence.
blockers.forbidden_shortcut: Do not turn semanticQualityClaimed to true from manifest editing alone.
blockers.required_test_or_probe: No-overclaim test must fail if semanticQualityClaimed=true appears before all promotion gates are passed.

blockers.required_repair: Create a truthful locator rewrite plan for a versioned candidate or explicit common path update, with rollback path and exact runtime loader expectations.
blockers.forbidden_shortcut: Do not claim runtime wiring from artifact-only locator entries.
blockers.required_test_or_probe: Locator rewrite test must assert runtime_wired and path update fields match the actual files selected for runtime loading.

blockers.current_evidence_ref: p19-existing-vs-candidate-comparison.json: existing checkpoint 1309772 bytes and 900 trained pair ids; candidate 17711 bytes and 19 trained pair ids
blockers.required_repair: Run side-by-side comparison against existing common checkpoint and choose either no promotion, versioned side-by-side promotion, or overwrite only after positive non-regression and rollback proof.
blockers.forbidden_shortcut: Do not overwrite models/skill-selection/skill-selection-v1 with the smaller candidate without comparison and rollback proof.
blockers.required_test_or_probe: Non-regression test must compare existing common and candidate outputs on the same source-disjoint scenario set.

blockers.current_evidence_ref: p19-existing-vs-candidate-comparison.json: candidate has fewer prompt keys and zero profiles in multiple sections
blockers.required_repair: Produce coverage gap report and either rebuild candidate with missing sections or explicitly choose versioned side-by-side promotion with narrower claim.
blockers.forbidden_shortcut: Do not treat smaller section coverage as equivalent to existing common model coverage.
blockers.required_test_or_probe: Coverage test must assert every promoted section has either positive evidence or an explicit no-promotion/narrow-scope decision.

blockers.current_evidence_ref: P19 explicitly performed no promotion and no rollback/load probe

blockers.forbidden_shortcut: Do not call rollback supported because previous files still exist.
blockers.required_test_or_probe: Rollback/load proof test must load candidate path and restored common path from disk with recorded hashes.

blockers.required_repair: After any promotion candidate path is selected, run fresh-load through XiigenExtensionApiService common loader and record response boundaries.
blockers.forbidden_shortcut: Do not substitute direct JSON parse or artifact import/export for runtime loader evidence.
blockers.required_test_or_probe: Runtime fresh-load test must invoke the same loader path used by XiigenExtensionApiService for SkillSelection.

blockers.current_evidence_ref: P17F API/firewall evidence predates any promotion and P19 did not change runtime behavior

blockers.required_test_or_probe: API/firewall rerun test must fail if any semantic/full readiness claim is true without the promotion evidence chain.
